primary_contract.quote: When you aren’t logged in to Amazon Web Services (unauthenticated mode), CloudTrail does not log the ConfirmSubscription or Unsubscribe actions.

observed_projection: ConfirmSubscription resources use the requested TopicArn, not the subscription token’s resolved original topic. Resource accountId is the authenticated caller account even when the ARN contains another account.
ConfirmSubscription successful responseElements retain subscriptionArn; request token is exactly REDACTED.

Unsubscribe resources use AWS::SNS::PlatformEndpoint with the full subscription ARN; resource accountId is the caller account. This remains true for cancellation, physical owner removal and semantic rejection.

Service semantic rejections retain requestParameters and use AuthorizationErrorException, NotFoundException or InvalidParameterException. The captured scoped-IAM denial uses AccessDenied and null requestParameters.
Native IAM authorization evaluates requested TopicArn: original-topic-only session policy denied requested other topic; requested-topic-only session succeeded using original subscription token.
bounds: Native capture is two accounts in us-east-1, standard SNS topics, SQS endpoint, one IAM user and assumed-role sessions. No other protocol/region/account-count claim.
Absence and owner-copy/event-sharing conclusions are bounded by recorded complete paginated EventHistory polling. Anonymous absence additionally has the explicit primary documentation contract.
Physical deletion and cancellation are independently distinguished by owner-readable attributes/list projection and final NotFound lookups, not inferred from successful Unsubscribe alone.

normalizations: Observation timestamps use request_started_ms/response_observed_ms for the existing SDK replay; captured timestamp values are unchanged. Executed capture sources retain their original field names.
